written: 2026-11-05, before any v11 job and before the v10 result
reason: All shipped members train on 5,592 of 7,000 labelled images. On fold 0, 60% to 80% of the data gave about +0.004 (ConvNeXt-S) and +0.007 (Swin-T) clean AUC per model, while recipe, backbone and stacking rounds gave at most +0.003. A refit on all labelled images is the largest lever left for test AUC.
recipe: the recipe of the v10 outcome: v10 passer with the highest tie-break mean, otherwise v8 p50. Fixed stopping, no selection on val: epoch 12 for resnet50 and swin_t, epoch 9 for convnext_small, chosen from the per-epoch mean score over 14 runs per arch (v7, v8, v9 logs), written to fixed.pt. The cosine schedule stays at 12 epochs.

trios.fx_s42: fold-0 split, seed 42, fixed.pt scored on val: the cost of dropping best.pt selection

candidate: full_s42 + full_s7, six members, equal mean_logit, orig+flip

switch_rule.gate_fixed: fx_s42 fixed.pt trio vs the best.pt trio of the same recipe and seed on val fold 0: clean and worst-of-23 point gains both >= -0.003, and no extended variant other than clean falls by more than 0.005
switch_rule.gate_sane: every refit member finishes, final train loss within 0.05 of its fx_s42 counterpart, bundle and inference pass the format check, test predictions have Spearman >= 0.8 with the current bundle (only a broken-model check, never used to choose between models)
switch_rule.gate_t4: cold run on a T4 under 240 s
switch_rule.pass: all gates: ship the refit bundle

limits: The refit has no held-out data, so its AUC cannot be measured. The expected gain is an extrapolation from 60% to 80% on fold 0. Val rows are in the refit training set, so val metrics of refit models must never be reported as estimates; reported figures stay those of the fold-0 models.
rerun_policy: rerun only for a crash, OOM or a run that did not learn.
never: test images in any statistic or training; the Spearman check selects nothing

results.note: refit has no held-out score; bundle rc 1 because the size assert (805 MB against the 500 MB limit in src/bundle.py) fired after the save, file complete
